title: Cold Caller / SDR (Sales Development Representative)
description:
Job Description



Are you the person your friends call "the closer"? Do you actually enjoy the phone — not tolerate it, enjoy it? BlackDoor Consulting Group is hiring cold callers who back themselves and want to get paid like it.





What You'll Do



You'll cold call business owners and set them up with a free strategy call where we help them get credit-ready and access funding. That's it. No closing, no pricing conversations, no fulfillment — just great conversations that turn into booked calls.



50 dials per day, minimum — no exceptions

10–15 live conversations per day

2–3 appointments booked per day

Every single call logged in GoHighLevel (GHL) — 100% of the time

Structured day: two power-dial blocks (morning and afternoon), a midday cleanup, and an EOD report posted to the team



We'll give you the script, the objection handling playbook, and a CRM workflow that removes the guesswork. You bring the energy and the discipline.



Bottom line on pay: total earnings are a mix of your negotiated base rate plus commission and bonuses tied to performance — the harder you work the number, the more it shows up in your paycheck.





What You Need to Bring



Real outbound cold-calling experience — this is not your first rodeo

Comfort with a performance-based pay structure (base + commission)

The discipline to hit a daily number, every day, without someone standing over you

Strong phone presence — warm, confident, and able to think on your feet through objections

Basic CRM comfort (we use GoHighLevel)





What This Role Is Not



You will not close deals, quote prices, or handle client fulfillment — that's the Account Executive's job

This is not a guaranteed-base role — the tiers are earned, not given

This is not a fit if you need certainty before you've proven performance





Wage/Salary



Base rate to be discussed based on experience. Commission is added on top of any negotiated base rate, paid per converted booking, so total pay scales with performance.



Estimated on-target earnings (OTE): $500–$1,500+/month, depending on tier and performance:



$50 commission per booked appointment that converts to a paying client

+$25/week activity bonus for hitting 50 dials/day, 5 days straight

+$100/month bonus for 5+ closed bookings in a month

Paid bi-weekly, on the 1st and 15th





How to Apply



Step 1 is a 60-second voice memo. Introduce yourself and tell us why you're great at this role. This is the whole filter — no memo, no interview. We're listening for tone, energy, confidence, and whether you can follow one simple instruction.



If your memo lands, you'll move to a short video screening call, then a live cold-call simulation before any offer goes out. We move fast — most hires happen within a week of posting.

title: Creative Marketer & Content Builder (AI-Powered) | Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
I run a fast-growing AI consulting business serving high-profile entrepreneurs in the German-speaking market, people with 7 to 8-figure yearly revenue. My developers can take on more clients than I can currently bring in. The bottleneck is me: I don't have the time or the head space to post every day, research trends, or write newsletters. That's not my job, it's yours.



I'm looking for one person who owns my marketing and turns attention into leads. Your single goal: get more of the right people to know me, so they become clients. Followers and views are nice, but they are not the point. Leads are the point.



**Who you'll work with**



You won't be alone. You'll join a small, tight team and work directly with me. I already have strong AI skills, my writing voice built into tools, and stacks of my call and coaching transcripts you'll pull from. The strategy direction comes fro
 and two senior marketing coaches I work with. You bring the creativity, the ideas, and the output. Lots of freedom from day one. You come to me daily with what you'd do, in most cases I'll say yes.



**What you will do**



- Write my LinkedIn posts: research trends, pull angles from my transcripts, write 1 to 2 posts per day in my voice (AI-assisted)

- Create the visuals for each post: strong, scroll-stopping images, made yourself or with AI

- Turn one piece of content into many: take a topic and cut it for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and a blog

- Write
 newsletters, WhatsApp broadcasts, and landing-page copy for lead magnets

- Market our lead magnets and drive people into my
 list and WhatsApp: we build the lead magnets (they're mostly custom skills), you handle the promotion. Build the landing pages with AI, write the posts, run the full lead chain, and tell us which lead magnets would land with this audience

- Bring ideas every day. You have a lot of creative freedom and I want you to use it.



All output is German, but you don't need to speak German. You work in English and use AI to translate both ways. That's a solved problem.



**What matters most to me**



You understand my audience. That's the whole game.



My clients are successful, busy entrepreneurs. Everyone wants a piece of their attention. So the person I hire has to respect their time and know exactly what this audience wants to see and what they don't. Serious, professional, high-value content. I need someone who has built personal brands for a serious, premium audience. Not someone whose "viral" work is cat videos.



If a design isn't 100% perfect once in a while, nobody at this level will hold it against me. What kills me is content that misreads the audience. Get the audience right, and the money follows.



I care about quantity you can keep up consistently. The quality bar on strategy I handle. You keep the volume of posts, images, and newsletters flowing.



**Must-have**



- Experience building personal brands for a serious, professional, premium audience (proof required)

- Strong creative sense: you come up with ideas, angles, and visuals, you don't wait to be told

- Can create scroll-stopping images with AI (this is a big plus, see below)

- Comfortable using AI tools daily to research, write, translate, and design (Mainly Claude AI)

- Writes excellent English copy that converts

- Works structured, hits a daily output rhythm, brings proposals proactively

- Honest and reliable



**A big plus**



- AI design: building landing pages and images with AI. This is our biggest gap right now. If you can design with AI, you move to the top of the pile.

- SEO / GEO understanding: building blog content that raises my visibility in search and in AI answers

- Video editing: later I want to build AI-avatar reels of me, daily, edited by you and posted to Instagram



**Where this grows**



This role grows fast if you're good:



- Managing and building my wife's personal brand

- Taking on marketing work for our clients directly (fast, high-volume marketing as a service)

- More responsibility, more income, quickly



I don't care how long you take or how you got there. I care about the result. Strong, fast, creative work is rewarded with raises, fast.



**Hours**



We work on Gulf Standard Time (Dubai, GMT+4). Team hours are 10 AM to 6 PM Dubai time, which is 2 PM to 10 PM your time in the Philippines. The whole team works the same hours. Short daily check-in, and a short written end-of-day report every day.



**Compensation**



Starting salary $600 USD/month, full-time, long-term. We start lean. Performance is rewarded fast: above-average work means steady raises and growing income over time.



**Who should not apply**



Don't apply if your background is generic social media management with no sense for a premium B2B audience. Don't apply if you chase cheap virality. And don't apply if you need someone to hand you every idea. I want a creative who thinks.



**How to apply**



Don't send me a long message or a full portfolio yet. Just text me "I'm in". That's it. I reply to everyone, and I'll tell you the next steps in the DMs.



Applications close after 60 applicants, which is usually within two days.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As a Recruiter:

Home care scheduling moves fast. A caregiver calls out at 6 AM, a shift needs covering in minutes, and one wrong detail (wrong client, wrong date, wrong caregiver) leaves a real senior without care. The Virtual Schedulers who thrive here stay calm under pressure, catch the small details other people miss, and follow through every single time. The ones who struggle need constant reminders, go quiet when things get busy, or treat "close enough" as good enough. Please be honest with yourself about which one you are before applying.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

• Exceptional attention to detail. You double-check names, dates, and shifts before you hit send.

• Strong English comprehension and clear, easily understood spoken English. You can fully understand American clients and caregivers on the phone, and they can easily understand you.

• Calm, organized, and decisive under pressure in a fast-changing environment

• Rock-solid reliability. You show up on time for every shift and give advance notice the 
nt anything affects your availability. No-call, no-show is an automatic disqualifier here.

• Initiative. You spot open shifts and problems and act on them without being told.

• Honesty and transparency. You will work with time-tracking software (Hubstaff). We want people who are proud of their work and have zero interest in gaming a tracker. Active, focused, honest work hours are required.

• A genuine commitment to stay long term. We invest heavily in training and we are looking for someone who wants to grow with one client for years, not move on in a few months.

• At least college undergraduate level



STRONGLY PREFERRED

• Prior experience as a scheduler or recruiter for a US home care or home health agency

• Hands-on experience with home care scheduling software (WellSky, AxisCare, SwyftOps, or similar)



YOUR HOME OFFICE MUST HAVE

• Reliable high-speed internet, plus a backup internet source

• A backup power source that can run your computer and internet through an outage

• A quiet, private, dedicated workspace with no background noise, TV, or family interruptions during your shift. This protects client confidentiality and your own professionalism.

(Full computer, internet, and backup-power specifications are listed on the application page. Please make sure you meet them before applying.)



WHY OUR VIRTUAL ASSISTANTS STAY

• Long-term placement with one client who invests in you as part of their team

• 80-plus hours of foundational training before you are placed, plus ongoing coaching

• Real recognition, including our VA of the Month program

• A supportive team and community that checks in on you and has your back



TO APPLY 

Apply on our careers page here:

title: On-Camera Host / Presenter
description:
About the Role:



We are a growing portfolio of online media brands serving engaged audiences across meaningful niches including mental health, personal development, and wellness. Our digital newsletters reach hundreds of thousands of readers daily, delivering valuable content that helps people live better lives.



We're looking for a natural-born conversationalist to become an on-camera face of our brand. You'll

interview experts across different niches — hosting podcasts, online events, and video content that people

actually want to watch.



This isn't a read-the-teleprompter gig. You'll research every guest deeply before you sit down with them,

ask the questions their audience wishes someone would ask, listen actively, and steer conversations to

the most interesting places. The camera should feel like your natural habitat, and talking to strangers

should energize you rather than drain you.



If you're the person who can strike up a genuine conversation with anyone, who gets curious about other

people's expertise, and who lights up when the recording starts — this role was written for you.



What You’ll Be Doing:

• Host and conduct on-camera interviews with experts across different niches — podcasts, video

interviews, and online events

• Research each guest thoroughly before the interview: their background, work, opinions, and recent

activity — and prepare a question flow that goes beyond the obvious

• Lead engaging, natural conversations: active listening, smart follow-up questions, and the ability to

redirect when a conversation drifts

• Present and host live online events (webinars, panels, Q&A sessions) with confidence and energy

• Collaborate with our content team to shape interviews into engaging content — knowing what makes

a clippable 
nt, a strong hook, or a shareable insight

• Represent the brand professionally on camera at all times: appearance, communication, and conduct

• Continuously improve your craft: reviewing your own footage, refining your interviewing style, and

studying great interviewers



Requirements:

• Proven experience in front of the camera: creating videos, hosting online events, running podcasts or

conducting interviews — you'll show us footage, not just tell us about it

• A natural extrovert and conversationalist — you genuinely enjoy talking to people and it shows on

screen

• Zero camera shyness: comfortable on live streams, recorded video, and in front of audiences

• Strong research skills — able to independently prepare for an interview with an expert in a field you

knew nothing about last week

• An instinct for engaging content: you understand pacing, hooks, and what keeps viewers watching

• Fluent English — clear, confident, and articulate on camera• Presentable and professional at all times: grooming, wardrobe, background, lighting, and demeanor

on every recording



Nice to Have:

• Basic video/audio production knowledge (framing, mic technique, recording setup) so remote

recordings look and sound professional

• Experience growing an audience on YouTube, a podcast platform, or social media

• Experience coordinating with guests: scheduling, prep calls, and making experts feel comfortable

before recording



Who This Role Is NOT For:

• People who freeze, stiffen, or script every word when the camera turns on

• Presenters who talk more than they listen — great interviews are about the guest

title: AI Lifestyle Imagery Designer
description:
About THOR Kitchen

THOR Kitchen designs professional-grade appliances built for those who take their kitchen and outdoor living seriously. From powerful gas ranges to sleek refrigeration and outdoor grills, our products are engineered to perform — and our marketing brings that standard to life visually. We're growing our creative team and looking for a designer who can help us show the world what life looks like with THOR in it.

In this role, you'll take our existing product renders and photography and composite them into aspirational, on-brand lifestyle scenes — kitchens, outdoor entertaining spaces, modern homes — that make our appliances the hero of the shot.

This is a hands-on production role that sits at the intersection of design craft and emerging AI tooling. If you love experimenting with tools like Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or Stable Diffusion and have a designer's eye for light, composition, and realism, we want to hear from you.

 campaigns, social media, website, paid advertising, and print collateral

What You Bring

•3+ years of professional design experience, with a strong portfolio of lifestyle, product, or commercial imagery

Role Overview

This is a single, end-to-end ownership role. You will be responsible for two interconnected pillars:



1. TikTok Shop Operations  —  Product listings, shop management, promotions, GMV Max campaigns, and shop growth.

2. Affiliate & Creator Management  —  Finding, onboarding, managing, and growing affiliates and creator partnerships that drive real GMV.



You will report directly to the founder and run both pillars independently with ongoing guidance. This is not a task-taker role — we need someone proactive and commercial who takes ownership of results.



Key Responsibilities

Pillar 1: TikTok Shop Operations

• Upload and optimize product listings across all brand shops — titles, descriptions, images, and product content optimized for conversion.

• Organize products correctly across different shops and brand accounts.

• Create and manage company posts and promotional content on TikTok accounts.

• Build and execute posting plans for brand TikTok accounts.

• Set up, launch, and monitor GMV Max campaigns to drive product visibility and sales.

• Monitor shop performance (traffic, conversion, sales) and proactively recommend improvements.

• Manage promotions, discounts, and TikTok Shop growth tools.

• Provide regular reporting, updates, and growth recommendations to the founder.



Pillar 2: Affiliate & Creator Management

• Review and vet affiliate applications for free product samples; assess audience fit, content quality, and performance history.

• Handle outreach and communication with affiliates and creators via
 tools (Euka) and DMs — set up global messages, segment by niche or performance tier, and keep affiliates engaged.

• Identify high-potential creators and negotiate monthly retainers ($300–$1,500) for 8–12 videos/month plus commission on sales.

• Draft offers, track deliverables, and optimise retainer arrangements for ROI.

• Manage our affiliate community (50+ members), run monthly contests rewarding top GMV generators and video posters with prizes.

• Use tools like Refunnel to track submissions, attribute sales, and maintain leaderboards.

• Coordinate sample shipments and track creator and affiliate activity end-to-end.

• Monitor creator performance, affiliate GMV, and engagement metrics — report weekly insights.

• Support expansion of affiliates onto Amazon attribution and Refersion for multi-channel growth.



Tools You'll Use

Comfort with the following tools is expected or quickly learnable:



• TikTok Shop Seller Center (listings, campaigns, GMV Max)

• Euka —
 automation and affiliate communications

• Refunnel — UGC tracking, sales attribution, leaderboards

• Canva — content briefs and basic creative assets

• Google Sheets — reporting, GMV tracking, performance dashboards

• Community management platform (
 or similar) for affiliate community



What We're Looking For

Required Experience

• Proven, hands-on experience managing live TikTok Shop accounts — not theoretical knowledge.

• Experience listing products into TikTok Shop and managing shop operations end-to-end.

• Track record in affiliate marketing, influencer management, or creator partnerships — with real GMV results to show.

• Good understanding of GMV Max and TikTok Shop growth levers.

• Strong e-commerce background — you understand conversion, not just content.



Skills & Traits

• Excellent written English for
s, DMs, and community management.

• Strong negotiation skills for creator retainers and partnership terms.

• Analytical mindset — comfortable with GMV, engagement rates, conversion metrics, and ROI.

• Highly organized with sharp attention to detail across multiple shops, brands, and creator relationships simultaneously.

• Proactive and commercial — you find ways to move things forward without being told.

• People person who builds genuine relationships with creators and affiliates.

• Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced remote environment.



Practical Requirements

• Full-time availability during US Pacific Time hours (6:30AM – 3:30 PM PST, Monday–Friday).

• Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace.

• Based in the Philippines or Pakistan (preferred for time zone alignment and platform familiarity).

• Available to start immediately following a short-paid test task.



How to Apply

Start your application with the phrase TIKTOK GROWTH at the top so we know you've read this carefully.



Then answer all of the following questions in your application:



1. What TikTok Shop accounts or brands have you worked on?

mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form

s or

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

Hook Writing: For every video topic provided, write a few high-converting hook options to grab attention in the first 2 seconds, based on successful UK top performing accounts.

Trend Tracking: Spend 1 hour a week researching rising audio trends and competitor styles within the UK property and influencer space.

Ad-Hoc Operational Support: Assist with administrative logistics, basic script writing support, and event planning coordination as needed.



2. Skool Operations & Admin - Platform Building & Upkeep



Text Formatting: Move and re-format raw text from documents, google sheets and PDFs into Skool. Follow our formatting and spacing rules, use bold paragraph titles and always paste our mandatory copyright header at the top of every page.

Resource Embedding: Embed tools and documents into Skool using html  codes. The tools must be made non-downloadable so experience in creating non-downloadable files is mandatory.

Community Vetting: Check incoming member requests for our group daily. Only approve people who fully answer the entry questions. Flag spam accounts or incomplete profiles to management immediately.

title: Senior Amazon Operation Officer
description:
About Amanak

Amanak is a premium ecommerce portfolio company. We build and operate brands that win on product quality and positioning, not price. Our flagship brand is a premium home goods brand with a strong Amazon presence, and we're actively launching new brands into the portfolio. This role is centered on our flagship brand's day-to-day Amazon operations, with light involvement in new brands as they get off the ground.

Role Summary

Are you a strategic, data-driven Amazon operator who's energized by optimization and brand growth? We're looking for an Amazon Account / Brand Operations Manager to own listing performance, conversion rate optimization, and brand presence across our portfolio. This is a leadership role within Amazon operations — you'll drive account health and sales growth through structured testing and data-backed decisions, not gut calls. This is a long-term seat with real growth potential in a lean, performance-driven team.

We're looking for someone who owns Amazon operations end-to-end for our flagship brand, catches problems before they become escalations, and runs a disciplined test-and-learn process to improve conversion. You'll also provide light support for new brands as Amanak launches them — these are early-stage and won't take up significant time, but you'll help get their Amazon presence off the ground. You'll start by shadowing the founder directly to learn how Amazon operations, promotions, and deal strategy currently run, before taking independent ownership. You'll report directly to the founder and work alongside a Finance/Inventory VA, a dedicated PPC manager, a TikTok affiliate manager, and a co-founder who owns supply chain and forecasting for the flagship brand.

Core Responsibilities

Account & Listing Management

• Own Amazon account management for our flagship brand day-to-day, plus light-touch setup and maintenance support for new brands as Amanak launches them.

• Own day-to-day health of all listings — titles, bullets, descriptions, images, A+ content, and backend keywords — to improve conversion and search ranking.

• Run a weekly account health and listing audit and monitor metrics daily (ODR, policy violations, performance notifications, inventory levels, pricing, Buy Box) — catch issues and bring recommendations before they're urgent, not after.

• Manage Amazon Brand Registry, A+ Content, and Brand Analytics reporting for the flagship brand and any new brand launches.

• Own a running A/B test roadmap (e.g., Amazon Manage Your Experiments) on titles, images, A+ content, and pricing — hypothesis, test, measure, iterate — don't wait to be told what to test.

Customer Service & Reputation

• Own Amazon CS end-to-end: responses, returns, refunds, reviews, and A-to-Z claim management.

• Escalate immediately anything above the agreed A-to-Z claim threshold or any pattern suggesting a product or listing issue.

FBA, Inventory & Reimbursements

• Manage FBA shipment creation, tracking, and receiving reconciliation.

• File and track reimbursement claims with Amazon for lost, damaged, or miscounted inventory.

• Investigate and resolve shipping discrepancies with Amazon and carriers.

• Support inventory forecasting by feeding sales velocity and demand signals into the reorder process; flag any SKU approaching the 45-day cover floor to Finance/Inventory. Forecasting decisions and PO placement remain owned by Finance/Inventory.

Market Intelligence & Reporting

• Track competitor activity and market trends to inform pricing and listing strategy.

• Pull and analyze sales, advertising, and traffic reports to identify growth opportunities.

• Deliver a weekly performance summary — sales, conversion, account health, top/bottom ASINs, and CS trends — in a consistent, skimmable format, pulled from Seller Central and Brand Analytics without hand-holding.

Promotions & Cross-Team Coordination

• Run Amazon deals, coupons, and promotions within pre-set parameters (Lightning Deals, coupons, Prime Day/BFCM calendar events).

• Coordinate with the broader team on inventory planning, promotions, and new product launches.

• Feed listing-side inputs (keywords, creative assets, A/B test results) to our dedicated PPC manager — this role does not run PPC campaigns.

Portfolio Support

• Primary ownership sits with the flagship brand — that's the priority, always.

• Provide light-touch Amazon setup and maintenance support for new brands as they launch. These are early-stage and shouldn't consume meaningful time; if a new brand ever starts competing for real bandwidth, flag it rather than letting flagship-brand work slip.

What This Role Does NOT Own

• PPC campaign management — owned by our dedicated PPC manager. This role feeds keyword, creative, and test-result inputs but does not build or run campaigns.

• Pricing, new product decisions, and supplier relationships — these stay with the founder.

• Forecasting ownership and PO placement — this role feeds data in, but Finance/Inventory makes the call.

Requirements

• 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts, including across multiple brands or SKUs.

• Experience with Amazon Brand Registry, A+ Content, and Amazon Brand Analytics.

• Direct experience with FBA shipment creation, reconciliation, and the reimbursement/case-filing process.

• Proven experience running structured A/B or split tests on Amazon listings (e.g., Manage Your Experiments) to improve conversion rate.

• Strongly analytical, data-first approach — comfortable forming a hypothesis, testing it, and iterating based on results rather than intuition.

• Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, complex formulas, data modeling).

• Working knowledge of inventory forecasting and reorder point calculations, to support — not replace — Finance/Inventory's forecasting process.

• Comfortable building a clean weekly report in Sheets/Excel without a template handed to you.

• Strong written English for CS, reviews, and Amazon case correspondence.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with Amazon PPC (Sponsored Products/Brands/Display) — not required since we have a dedicated PPC manager, but helpful for speaking the same language on what's working.

• Experience using Claude or other AI tools to support listing optimization, testing analysis, or reporting workflows.

• Experience with third-party tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar).

• Exposure to TikTok Shop Seller Central (useful for backup coverage, not a core requirement).

• Experience with regulated or highly compliance-sensitive product categories (e.g., supplements), given our expanding portfolio.

• Prior experience in a lean, founder-led company where ownership matters more than task lists.

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Weeks 1–2: Shadow the founder on current Amazon operations, the promotion calendar, and deal strategy to learn how things run today before taking ownership.

• Zero missed escalation triggers — account health, A-to-Z claims, days-of-cover — are always caught before the founder has to ask.

• First clean weekly performance report delivered by week 3, consistent by week 6.

• First structured A/B test live, with a documented hypothesis and results readout, by week 6.

• Full independent ownership of flagship-brand Amazon operations by day 90, with new-brand support running smoothly alongside it.



Some questions for candidates to answer when submitting resume, add or remove questions as needed. To help you filter people out before first interview.



To be considered for this role, please respond to the following:



Can you commit to full-time hours, 6:30am–3:00pm PST, Monday–Friday?

Describe your internet speed and how often you experience power or internet outages. What is your backup plan if either goes down mid-shift?

How many ASINs/SKUs have you managed at once, and across how many separate Amazon brands or accounts?

Have you filed FBA reimbursement claims with Amazon? Roughly how many, and what were the outcomes?

Have you run an A/B test on an Amazon listing (e.g., Amazon Manage Your Experiments, Splitly, PickFu)? Describe the test and the result.

Please rate yourself 1–10 (10 being expert) on: Google Sheets/Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP); Amazon Seller Central; Amazon Brand Analytics; Amazon A+ Content Manager; Amazon Manage Your Experiments or a similar split-testing tool; Canva/Photoshop or similar.

Give 3 examples that demonstrate your attention to detail in past Amazon-related work.

title: Appointment Setter For Leading Land Investing Company
description:
Heads up: this listing is long on purpose. We need you to read it. There are instructions buried inside that tell us whether you actually did. Skim and you're out.



Who we are



The Land Pioneer (
) is a vacant land acquisitions and dispositions business. We buy raw land at a discount, then sell it. Appointment setting is a critical link in our pipeline — you're the bridge between a raw lead and a real conversation with our acquisitions team. Without well-set, well-qualified appointments, nothing else moves.



Who we're looking for



We're hiring an appointment setter who already knows how to work the phone. We are NOT going to train you on:



How to handle objections

How to build rapport in the first 15 seconds

What a motivated seller actually sounds like

Why "just thinking about it" isn't a real objection



If you're early in your sales career and looking for someone to teach you scripts and tonality, this isn't the role. We need someone experienced, a person who can pick up a phone, navigate a conversation, keep a stranger on the line, and know within two minutes whether the person on the other end is worth an appointment with our acquisitions team, a follow-up later, or a polite goodbye. You should be able to filter hot from cold without us looking over your shoulder, and lock in a firm, confirmed appointment when the lead is real.



Must-haves



Real estate phone experience in the US market (appointment setting, cold calling, or inside sales). Vacant land experience is a major plus and will likely earn you a higher starting rate.



Neutral or American accent with strong English fluency. You should sound like someone a US property owner would comfortably talk to for ten minutes without feeling like they're on a "sales call."



A proven track record. We will ask for references and metrics, dials per day, contact rates, appointments set, show rates.



Recorded calls we can listen to. Non-negotiable. If you don't have them, don't apply. Redact PII where needed, but we want to hear you in action, wins and tough calls both.



Reliable internet, a quality headset, a quiet workspace, and the ability to overlap with US time zones.



Organization and follow-through. Setting the appointment is half the job, confirming it, reminding the seller, and making sure they actually show up is the other half.



Adaptability. Our process evolves. We test scripts, swap list sources, refine criteria. You should welcome that, not resist it.

What you'll be doing



Calling warm and cold property owner leads from lists and pipelines we provide

Using our software to look at property features while you talk

Building rapport quickly, finding motivation, qualifying or disqualifying fast

Booking qualified sellers directly onto our Acquisition Managers' calendars

Confirming appointments and sending reminders to maximize show rates

Rescheduling no-shows and reviving stalled leads with consistent follow-up

Logging clean notes in our CRM so the AM walks into every call prepared

Hitting daily and weekly KPIs on dials, contacts, appointments set, and appointments held



Compensation



Hourly rate: $5–$7/hr, based on experience and verifiable track record. Candidates with vacant land experience and strong metrics will start at or near the top of the range.



How to apply, read carefully, this IS the filter



 
 with everything below. Missing pieces get your application moved to the trash.



1. Subject line — use this exact format: Appointment Setter Application — [Your Name] — [Years of RE Phone Experience]



2. The very first line of your
 body must read: I read the whole post — here's my pitch. If this line is missing, you don't make it to the next round. We mean it.



3. Attach or link the following:



Your resume (PDF preferred)



2–3 recorded calls. At least one should be a call where you turned a cold or skeptical prospect into a booked appointment or a real conversation. Add a one-line note telling us what to listen for.



A Loom video, 3–5 minutes max, introducing yourself and walking us through (a) what you know about the US real estate industry and (b) what you know, or want to learn, about vacant land specifically. Talk to the camera the way you'd talk to a seller. We're evaluating presence, not just content.



4. In the body of the
, answer these three questions briefly:



What's the #1 thing you do in the first 20 seconds of a call to keep someone on the line?



Tell us about an appointment or deal you set up that you're proud of — what made the seller motivated, and how did you uncover it?



What do you do between setting an appointment and the appointment time to make sure the seller actually shows up?



5. At the very bottom of your
, write one sentence about something on 
 that stood out to you. One sentence is enough — we just want to know you looked.



What happens next



We review applications in the order they come in. If your call recordings and Loom land, we'll set up an interview and if everything checks out, you're in, and we move fast.



if no interview is setup in first 7 days, please understand we have not shortlisted you and won't be moving forward with your application



We're not the right fit for everyone. But if you're a real phone pro who's tired of being underpaid, micromanaged, or handed scripts you didn't help build — we'd love to hear from you.



Newman The Land Pioneer

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)
description:
Title:

AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)



Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: NSW Property Research Assistant / Real Estate Due Diligence VA
description:
We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Property Research Assistant based in the Philippines to research residential and development properties in New South Wales, Australia.



This is a remote role for someone who is organised, careful, good with online research, and confident using spreadsheets.



You will help with early-stage property due diligence. The goal is to assess whether a property has potential for renovation, subdivision, duplex development, a granny flat, knockdown rebuild, townhouse development, or other value-add opportunities.



You do not need to be a town planner, architect or builder. Training and templates will be provided. However, you must be accurate, willing to learn, and careful not to guess.



Main responsibilities:



Review property listings and enter details into research templates

Check property zoning using NSW planning websites

Review basic planning controls such as lot size, frontage, setbacks, height limits, floor space ratio and minimum lot size

Check for site risks such as flood, bushfire, heritage, easements, slope and other constraints

Research council LEPs, DCPs and online maps

Research comparable property sales and rental evidence

Run basic cash flow and feasibility reports using provided spreadsheets 

Prepare simple property summary notes

Flag risks, missing information or items that need professional review

Keep research files and spreadsheets organised



The right person will have:



Strong attention to detail

Good English reading and writing skills

Strong online research skills

Good spreadsheet skills, especially Google Sheets or Excel

Ability to follow step-by-step instructions

Ability to work independently and ask questions when something is unclear

A careful and methodical approach

Interest in property, real estate, construction, finance or development



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



Real estate research

Property data entry

Australian property research

Government or council websites

Google Maps or online mapping tools

Excel or Google Sheets

Cash flow or feasibility spreadsheets

Construction, architecture, drafting, engineering, town planning or property investment support



Important:



Accuracy is very important. This role is not just copying data. The assistant needs to carefully check information, think through the details, and clearly explain what they find.



We are looking for someone who can help identify good property opportunities and also help avoid costly mistakes.



Work arrangement:



Remote work from the Philippines

Part-time to start

Ongoing work available for the right person

Flexible hours, but deadlines must be met

Paid hourly or per completed research task, depending on experience

Initial paid trial task will be provided



To apply, applicants must include:



Their experience with research, real estate, admin or spreadsheets

Any experience with property, construction, planning, finance or development

Their hourly rate in PHP

Their weekly availability

Their computer and internet setup

Examples of research, spreadsheet or reporting work if available

Please answer this question in your application:



If you were given a residential property listing in NSW, Australia, what are the first 5 things you would check to assess its development potential?

title: Virtual Stylist & Wardrobe Curator (Hourly, Temporary)
description:
About the Role

I’m looking for a thoughtful, fashion-minded virtual stylist to help me bring order, creativity, and fresh vision to my existing wardrobe. I’ve already photographed my clothes, shoes, bags, and jewelry. Now, I need your eye to help me put it all together.



This is a remote position where you’ll help me create styled looks for different parts of my life: speaking engagements, church services, real estate client meetings, casual outings, travel days, and formal events. We’ll use the Indyx iOS app to build and organize my wardrobe, and I’ll cover the premium subscription if needed.



You won’t need to shop for me or build a wardrobe from scratch. I simply need help refining and coordinating what I already own into outfits that are appropriate, elegant, and true to who I am.



A Little About Me



I’m a minister, real estate broker, and author based in Tennessee. I show up in many different spaces — from pulpits to closing tables to Sunday brunch — and I want my wardrobe to reflect confidence, modesty, purpose, and grace. My style is a blend of sophistication and professionalism, with a touch of Afrocentric flair.



What You’ll Be Doing:

Access my wardrobe photos inside the Indyx app and help me organize them by category, color, and occasion

Create polished and appropriate outfits for specific events like:



Sunday services

Real estate closings and networking

Speaking engagements (in person and virtual)

Brunch or lunch with friends

Travel and formal events

Build lookbooks and mood boards in the app so I can easily find what to wear

Tag each item and outfit with helpful details like occasion, season, and location

Suggest styling adjustments, accessory pairings, or layering options

Use the app’s built-in photo editor to clean up background images and help the catalog look its best

Provide brief notes or explanations for each outfit so I understand how to pull it together myself



What I’m Looking For:



Someone with experience in styling, wardrobe curation, or fashion coordination

A person who understands how to work with modest, professional, ministry-appropriate clothing

Comfortable using iOS and willing to work inside the Indyx app (training provided if needed)

Organized and good at communicating clearly and kindly

Someone who enjoys helping others look and feel their best

Bonus if you have experience building digital lookbooks or working with speakers or professionals

Details:



This is a short-term project paid by the hour

Please include your hourly rate when you apply



We’ll begin with a paid trial task (such as styling 3 to 5 looks) and move from there



I’d love to get started right away, with the project expected to last around 3 to 4 weeks, depending on how we pace it



To Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself and your styling background

Your hourly rate

Any examples of work you’ve done; especially for clients who speak, teach, or lead professionally

Confirmation that you use an iOS device and are open to working inside the Indyx app

title: Customer Service Representative – Fashion Dropship (Remote, Part-Time)
description:
We are looking for a motivated, empathetic, and commercially minded Customer Service Representative to join our growing e-commerce team. We run fashion dropshipping stores targeting American women, with plans to expand to other countries in the future.



About the role



You will be managing customer service for two Shopify fashion stores. Currently these stores receive around 30
s per day combined. As the stores grow, and as additional stores are added, your responsibilities and salary will grow with them.



This is more than just a CS job. If you perform well, there is a real opportunity to grow into a CS Manager role as we expand and bring on more tea
mbers across multiple brands.



What you'll do





Respond to at least 90% of customer
s within 12 hours, and 100% within 24 hours — 7 days a week. When you can respond doesn't matter to us; that it happens every day, without gaps, does.

Handle inquiries, complaints, refund requests, and order issues professionally across both stores

Guide customers toward fair resolutions in line with our policy — always aim for the lowest refund amount that still resolves the issue (e.g. a partial refund or discount-to-keep-the-item before a full refund), while also protecting our chargeback rate: if a full refund is what it takes to avoid a chargeback or a customer dispute, that takes priority over minimizing the amount

Recognize when a customer may be heading toward a chargeback or dispute, and escalate to the manager early — not after it has already escalated

If you're unsure about policy, pricing, stock, or any specific situation — always ask before responding to the customer. We would always rather answer a quick question from you than fix a mistake with a customer afterward.

Log every refund/discount commitment immediately in the shared refund tracker at the 
nt a customer agrees — not afterward, not "when there's time"

Maintain a warm, personal, boutique tone of voice in every message — customers should always feel like a real person helped them

Use professional, natural American English in all communications — never corporate or robotic, and never a copy-pasted script

Use DeepL for any translation needs as we expand to new markets

Communicate proactively — if something comes up (you're unwell, unavailable, or a case is tricky), you let us know in advance, not after the fact





What we're looking for





Excellent written English with a natural, warm tone

Empathetic but business-minded — you know how to handle a frustrated customer and guide them toward a resolution without giving away more than necessary

Comfortable working with templates and SOPs as a guideline, not a script — every customer is different and replies should always feel personal and adapted

A habit of double-checking rather than guessing — you verify facts (policy, stock, pricing) before telling a customer something, and you follow up on your own commitments until they're actually resolved

Proactive communicator — you don't wait to be asked, you keep us updated

Experience with dropshipping (any niche) is a strong plus

Experience specifically with fashion dropshipping will be given top priority

Customer service experience is a plus

Experience with Shopify is required

Available to start immediately

Preferably available during US business hours





What we offer





€200/month starting salary, based on ~30
s/day across two stores

Salary grows as
 volume increases, based on the average daily
 volume across both stores over the previous calendar month (calculated automatically from our helpdesk reporting):



30
s/day: €200

35
s/day: €215

40
s/day: €230

45
s/day: €245

50
s/day: €260

55
s/day: €275

60
s/day: €290







You're welcome to use AI tools to help draft replies faster — but every reply must be checked against our actual policies (we'll provide a policy/FAQ doc) and adjusted to sound personal, not generic. Sending an AI-generated reply without verifying it against our policy is treated the same as guessing.

Opportunity to take on CS for additional stores as we expand — compensation grows accordingly

Clear path to CS Manager as the team grows

title: Agency Marketing & Creative, Social Media and Content
description:
The NES| Remote-friendly | Freelance/contract to start, scaling as the agency grows



Read this whole post. The application instructions at the bottom filter out 90% of people, and anyone who skips them gets deleted.



The NES is a brand partnerships collective working across sport, entertainment and culture. We advise and we deliver, across partnerships, marketing, events and content. We're a new agency with a point of view, and we need someone to make sure the world sees it. Your job is to build our presence, sharpen our brand, and turn attention into new business.



What you'll do



1. Polish the website.

Our site is built in Framer and it's close, but not finished. You'll work with the founder to tighten the copy, visuals and flow so it converts the attention your content creates.



2. Build our social channels from the ground up.

LinkedIn, TikTok and Instagram. You'll set the content strategy, create the assets, write the copy and post consistently. Each channel does a different job, and you'll know what that job is.



3. Write content that positions us.

Industry posts, opinion pieces and content that shows we know sport, entertainment and culture better than the agencies twice our size. The goal isn't likes. It's brand directors seeing our name enough times that when our BD team lands in their inbox, we're already familiar.



4. Drive new business.

Everything above serves the pipeline. You'll work alongside our business development lead so content and outreach pull in the same direction.



Who this is for

- You've used social media to actually grow a business, and you can show the before and after

- You can design, write and edit. You don't need a team of three to ship one post

- You write clean, natural English with personality. Nothing that reads like a template or like AI wrote it

- You're across what's working right now on LinkedIn, TikTok and Instagram, not what worked in 2023

- You have a genuine feel for sport, entertainment or culture. This space rewards people who actually care about it



Who this is NOT for

- People who post pretty content that goes nowhere commercially

- People who need a brief for every single post

- Anyone who'd pad engagement numbers or buy followers to make results look better. We'll know, and it ends the trial immediately



How the trial works

- Four-week paid trial

- You'll build out a plan to build our presence, set a content strategy and start shipping. Real posts, live channels, from week one

- Strategy and brand voice get agreed with the founder before anything goes out

- Pass = channels growing with the right audience, and content that's visibly building our position in the industry

- Show a clear line from your content to a new business conversation in those four weeks and you're locked in at the top of the range



Pay



[$400 - $550/month base depending on experience], with scope to grow as the agency does. Do this well and the role grows with the business you helped build.



How to apply (required, no exceptions)

- Start your message with the word CREATIVE so we know you read this far

- Send examples of past work: accounts you've run, content you've made, campaigns you've shipped

- Tell us how you've used social media to grow a business, with numbers where you have them

- Identify two or three current trends businesses should be using right now to grow and engage the right audiences

- Include any blog posts or long-form pieces you've written



Miss any of those five and you're auto-rejected.

title: AI Growth Builder & Outbound Marketer (we build our own): property tech + new SaaS, remote
description:
AI Growth Builder and Outbound Marketer (global outreach), remote



The short version

We are a European property-tech group, and we are building something bigger. We need someone who uses AI to reach the right people in every market and turns that reach into real action on our platforms: agents listing their properties and getting viewings booked, agencies coming on board. Think AI-driven
, AI calling, and social outreach that gets people to like and share, country by country, in the local language. Important: we build and own our systems. We are not looking for someone who rents a pile of subscriptions, we want someone who builds the engine with us so we own it and reuse it. On top of that, you can pick up the broader marketing work too: content, social, basic SEO, paid, analytics.



Who we are

We run several live rental and property platforms in the European market on one shared codebase, plus a new SaaS for the staffing and recruitment sector. We move fast, we test thoroughly, and we reward people who prove results.



How we work (important)

- We build and own our tools. We prefer building over renting. Less vendor lock-in, more control, and everything we build we reuse across our platforms.

- That means working at the level of APIs, your own scripts, and your own automations, not clicking together a stack of expensive closed services.

- You build it once, we own it, and it keeps paying off across every channel and every country.



What you will do (the core)

- Build AI-powered, multi-channel outreach that we own and that scales worldwide, market by market:
 at volume, AI calling, social, and WhatsApp where it fits.

- For the property platform: reach real estate agents in every market and bring them onto the platform, listing their properties and getting viewings booked. The AI calls and messages carry one clear call to action: visit the site and get started.

- For the SaaS: reach staffing and recruitment agencies and get them on board and active in the same way.

- It is one engine for both products. You build it once and it runs for property and for staffing, country by country.

- Make it work in any language. Build a reliable localization approach so the outreach reads native in each market, using AI translation with quality control and native review where it matters. Rough machine translation does not cut it; the message has to feel local, not foreign.

- Drive social amplification: get agents and agencies to follow, like, and share our content, so reach compounds.

- Build the lead data, sequences, and automations yourself, and keep them deliverable and legal in every market you touch: GDPR in Europe, anti-spam laws such as CAN-SPAM, and local rules on
 and automated calling. Warmed domains, clear opt-out, and consent where it is required. Compliance and deliverability are part of the job, not an afterthought.

- Measure everything: replies, signups, activations, and double down on what works.



What you will do (the bonus, all-round)

- Content and social management, basic SEO, paid campaigns, simple design, reporting.



How you build it (we like builders, not renters)

- Comfortable wiring up LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) in your own workflows.

- Comfortable with self-hostable automation (for example n8n) and your own scripts over closed SaaS where it makes sense.

- Can build your own lead data, localization, and outreach pipeline instead of depending on one paid platform.

- For AI calling, you wire telephony and voice models yourself rather than relying on a closed black box.

If you already build your own automations instead of renting them, tell us. That is exactly who we want.



Who you are

- You think in systems and you build and own them.

- You have grown something real and can show it, with a number.

- You are comfortable with volume, testing, and iteration.

- You write clear English, and you have a proven way to make outreach read natively in many other languages (AI localization with quality control, native review where it matters). You do not rely on rough machine translation.

- You respect the law in each country you reach into, and you treat compliance as part of doing it well, not a brake. You know that automated calling in particular is tightly regulated and you handle it carefully, market by market.

- You are self-starting and reliable, and you keep brands safe (no spammy shortcuts that get domains blacklisted).



The deal

- Remote, full-time preferred. We start at a fair entry rate and raise it quickly for people who prove results.

- We test with a small paid task first, then move fast for the right person.

- As we scale this across both products and more markets, there is room for it to grow into more than one role.



How to apply (please read)

1. Start your message with the word GROWTH so I know you read this.

2. In a few lines, answer this: how would you reach 10,000 real estate agents in one country using AI, end to end, how would you keep it legal and deliverable there (think GDPR, anti-spam, and rules on automated calling), how would you make the outreach read natively in that country's language, and which parts would you build yourself versus rent?

3. Add one example of something you have grown, with a number.

Applications that skip these get less attention. We reply to serious ones quickly.

title: Business Development & Account Manager, Brand Partnerships
description:
The Nes | Remote-friendly | Freelance/contract to start, scaling as deals close



Read this whole post. The application instructions at the bottom filter out 90% of people, and anyone who skips them gets deleted.



The NES is a brand partnerships collective working across sport, entertainment and culture. We advise and we deliver, across partnerships, marketing, events and content. We're a disrupter entering the space, which means the pipeline doesn't exist yet. You're the one building it, and converting it.



What you'll do



1. Build our creds deck.

Work with the founder to shape a sharp credentials deck covering our services and capabilities. You'll use it as your core sales tool, so make it something you'd actually want to send.



2. Cold outreach across Australia, New Zealand and Asia.

Build targeted lists of brands that fit a partnerships collective in sport, entertainment and culture. Run cold outreach over
, LinkedIn and DM using your own proven approach. Book calls, hand over warm qualified conversations, or close the smaller ones yourself once you know our offer inside out.



3. Build the pipeline and the system behind it.

We're a new agency. There's no CRM full of leads waiting for you. You'll set up the pipeline and the tracking to go with it: volume sent, reply rates, calls booked, deals landed. To support this, you'll also co-manage The Nes LinkedIn page alongside our marketing manager and founder, so the brands you're contacting see a live, credible agency when they look us up.



4. Bridge business development and servicing.

When a deal lands, you're the handover. Depending on size and scale, you'll either transition the client to our accounts team or stay on the account yourself. Either way, the client should never feel the seam between sales and delivery.



Who this is for

- You've run cold B2B or agency outreach before and can show the numbers: volume sent, reply rates, deals closed

- You've built pipeline and outreach systems from scratch, not just inherited someone else's

- You bring your own outreach system. We're not teaching you how to cold

- You write clean, natural English that doesn't read like a template or like AI wrote it

- You're relentless on follow-up. You know the deal is in the third and fourth
, not the first

- You understand sponsorship, partnerships or sports/entertainment marketing well enough to hold a credible conversation with a brand director



Who this is NOT for

- People who've only done inbound or account management with no hunting

- People who blast the same generic
 to 500 brands

- Anyone who'd inflate our capabilities or invent case studies to land a deal. We'll know, and it ends the trial immediately



How the trial works

- Four-week paid trial

- You start with a blank page. No creds deck, no client list. Building both is the job, and the trial is where you prove you can

- Your target list and outreach approach get approved before anything goes out

- Pass = real brands replying and qualified calls booked from your cold outreach

- Land a signed deal in the trial and you're locked in at the top of the range



Pay

- [$400 to $800/month base depending on experience], plus uncapped commission on every closed deal. Commission is negotiated per deal based on size and scale, so the earning potential here is as big as you make it. Strong closers will out-earn the base many times over.



How to apply (required, no exceptions)

- Start your message with the word PARTNERSHIPS so we know you read this far

- Paste ONE cold outreach
 you've actually sent that got a reply. A real one

- Tell us your best reply rate on a past campaign and roughly how many
s it covered

- In one sentence: what makes a cold
 get answered instead of deleted?





Miss any of those four and you're auto-rejected.

title: End-to-End VSL Creative Producer for Meta Ecommerce Ads — Scriptwriting, AI Video, Editing
description:
IMPORTANT: To apply, you must send examples of VSL/direct-response video ads that you personally created end-to-end, including scriptwriting and editing. If you only edit finished scripts, this is not the right role.



I am looking for an end-to-end VSL creative producer for a new direct-response ecommerce brand we are starting from scratch. 



You will be in charge of making VSLs for Meta ads.



This is not a basic video editing role.



I need someone who can take product research, avatar research, angle direction, and brand information, then turn that into a high-converting VSL-style video ad from start to finish.



About me:



I have previously scaled an ecommerce brand to over $300,000/month in revenue, primarily using direct-response paid ads.



Now I am starting a new ecommerce brand from scratch and looking to build a strong creative team around it. The goal is to scale aggressively and reach $1,000,000/month in revenue within the next year.



Because this is a new brand, I am looking for strong early hires who can move fast, think deeply, and take ownership of creative output. Before hiring full-time, I want to test people through paid one-off projects.



This first project is a paid trial. If the work is strong, we may do more paid one-off projects. If those go well and the brand shows traction, this can turn into a long-term full-time role with base pay, performance bonuses, and the opportunity to grow into a managerial creative role.



Long-term opportunity:



If you perform well and become an early hire, there is a lot of room to grow.



You could eventually take ownership of:



* VSL scripting

* Creative strategy

* Avatar and angle research

* AI video generation workflows

* Video editing systems

* Creative testing output

* Managing other editors, writers, and designers

* Building the creative department as the brand scales



I am looking for someone who wants more than a simple task-based editing job. I want someone who is hungry, detail-oriented, strong at direct-response storytelling, and excited about helping scale a new ecommerce brand from the ground up on Meta.



What you should be good at:



* Direct-response marketing

* Ecommerce ads on Meta

* VSL scriptwriting

* Hook writing

* Avatar/customer research

* Understanding customer pain points

* Translating product research into persuasive scripts

* Video editing

* AI voiceover tools

* AI video generation tools

* Finding relevant B-roll

* Generating B-roll with AI when needed

* Creating native, high-retention video ads for Meta



Tools/skills that are helpful:



* CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar

* ElevenLabs, PlayHT, or other AI voiceover tools

* Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Veo, Pika, or other AI video tools

* Canva, Figma, or simple graphics tools

* AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc

* Strong English comprehension and storytelling ability

* Ability to use AI intelligently without creating generic AI-sounding work



This paid project:



This is a highly open-ended paid project.



We will provide:



* Brand details

* Product information

* Offer details

* Our own deep research

* Target avatar

* Exact angle to create the ad around

* General direction for the VSL

* Competitor/reference examples 

* Any claims or wording to avoid

* Brand assets/product images if available



Your job is to take those resources, understand the product and customer, then create the Video Sales Letter.



You will be responsible for:



* Reading and understanding the research

* Thinking through the best hook and script structure

* Writing the full VSL script

* Creating the visual flow

* Finding relevant B-roll

* Generating B-roll with AI when needed

* Creating or sourcing AI voiceover

* Editing the final video

* Adding captions, overlays, zooms, callouts, and simple graphics

* Creating hook variations

* Delivering launch-ready videos



Deliverables:



1. One full VSL script

   The script should be direct-response focused, emotionally compelling, and built around the avatar and angle provided.



2. One finished VSL-style video ad

   Length: 2 minutes to 2 minutes 30 seconds

   Format: 9:16 vertical

   Style: direct-response, native, clear, persuasive, mobile-friendly, and geared toward customers in the USA aged 50+



3. Three hook variations

   Create three different opening hooks for the video.



4. Three total video files

   The body of the video can stay mostly the same, but each version should have a different opening hook.



5. Visuals/B-roll

   Use relevant B-roll, product visuals, graphics, and AI-generated clips where needed.



6. Captions and editing

   The final videos should include clean captions, strong pacing, visual variety, and mobile-readable text.



7. Short thought-process report

   Include a short, concise report explaining:



* Why you chose the hook

* Why you structured the script the way you did

* Why you chose the visuals/B-roll

* What customer emotion or pain point you were trying to target

* What you think makes the ad persuasive



Important rules:



* Do not copy competitor ads word-for-word.

* Do not use copyrighted clips unless clearly licensed or approved.

* Do not invent fake studies.

* Do not create generic AI-sounding copy.

* Do not make the video feel like a polished brand commercial.

* The ad should feel direct-response, native, emotionally clear, and built to sell.

* You are allowed to use aggressive direct-response techniques.

* You are allowed to generate AI Avatars and Authority Figures including doctors



Compensation:



This first project is a paid one-off trial.



Project pay:

$150 for the completed project.



If the work is strong, we may do additional paid one-off projects before considering a full-time role.



Long-term full-time opportunity:



If you perform well and the brand scales, this role can become a full-time position.



A future full-time role may include:



* Stable monthly base pay (2.5-5k USD / month or much more if promoted to Creative Director)

* Performance bonuses for winning ads (% of ad spend on winning ads made by you or under you if you are Creative Director)

* Bonuses when ads hit spend/profitability milestones

* Monthly team bonuses if the brand hits revenue and profitability targets

* Opportunity to move into a creative manager or VSL creative director role as the team grows

* Significantly higher earning potential for exceptional performance as the brand scales



The goal is to reward people who help us create ads that actually win. For this one-time project, no performance bonus will be given. However, if you are hired for a full-time role based on your performance on the one-time project(s), you will be offered generous bonuses.



To apply, please include:



1. Your best VSL or direct-response video ad examples that were made completely by you. Feel free to show as many as you want. You must have handled both scriptwriting and editing

2. The AI tools you use for end-to-end VSL creation, including AI voiceover tools, AI copywriting tools, and AI video generation tools

3. Your editing software

4. Your experience with direct-response ecommerce ads, specifically VSLs

5. Your experience with avatar/customer research for ecommerce

6. Your AI tool stack for VSL creation

7. A brief explanation of your exact role in each portfolio example: script, editing, voiceover, B-roll, AI visuals, or strategy

8. **The phrase “VSL creative producer” in your subject line so I know you read this**



Please do not apply if you only edit videos from finished scripts.



Again, your application must include portfolio examples and a clear explanation of what you personally did on each one. Applications without relevant VSL/direct-response examples will not be considered.



I am looking for someone who can think through the hook, script, visuals, B-roll, AI generation, and final edit from a research packet.



You must be independent, hard working, and creative.



This is a big opportunity for the right person. We are starting from scratch, but the goal is to move very fast and build something large. If you are strong, reliable, hungry, and can create ads that perform, there is serious long-term upside.



Expect a reply if you are a good fit within 24 hours.
